Se você começou sua carreira como desenvolvedor(a), cresceu dominando arquitetura, performance e integrações de sistemas, e hoje atua como líder técnico(a) ou coordenador(a), essa vaga é para você.

Buscamos alguém com uma mentalidade proativa, que tenha facilidade em aprender e dominar diferentes ferramentas e soluções, sempre buscando inovação e eficiência. Se você tem um perfil dinâmico, gosta de trabalhar em ambientes que exigem agilidade e adaptação constante, e é motivado por resultados, venha fazer parte de nossa equipe!

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar técnica e estrategicamente equipes de produto e desenvolvimento, com foco em entregas consistentes, qualidade técnica e desenvolvimento de pessoas;
  • Traduzir a estratégia do negócio em soluções tecnológicas robustas, garantindo a viabilidade técnica e a aderência ao roadmap da área;
  • Participar ativamente das decisões técnicas, atuando como referência para o time em arquitetura, boas práticas de desenvolvimento e stack .NET;
  • Gerenciar projetos de ponta a ponta, acompanhando cronogramas, riscos, dependências e recursos;
  • Promover integração com stakeholders, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas técnicas e não técnicas;
  • Conduzir melhorias de processo, adotando metodologias ágeis e práticas de governança alinhadas à cultura da empresa;
  • Atuar como facilitador(a) de conflitos, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo, produtivo e inovador.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Sólida experiência com C# e .NET/.NET Core (preferencialmente no início da carreira), com histórico prático em desenvolvimento de software;
  • Atuação atual ou recente em coordenação/liderança de equipes ou projetos na área de tecnologia ou produto digital;

SBM Offshore is the world’s deepwater ocean‑infrastructure expert. Our work is already resulting in cleaner, more efficient energy production. True. Blue. Transition. is our promise to enable that into the future while at the same time using our expertise to support new and existing markets in the blue economy. Background

  • The Technician Lead must show strong safety behaviour acting as a safety culture disseminator.
  • They will ensure all procedures are followed and that O &M Contractor and local regulatory compliance are met in all aspects of work.
  • The Technician Lead is responsible for executing maintenance and preservation tasks efficiently and safely to ensure the reliability and longevity of equipment. This role involves performing a variety of maintenance and preservation activities, including but not limited to cleaning, housekeeping, blasting, spraying/painting, isolation and reinstatement, greasing application, and the preservation of topside items like flanges, bolts and valves.
  • They are also responsible for ensuring that their supervisor is made aware of all activities according to procedure, especially when safety is an issue.
  • The Technician Lead will demonstrate exemplary safety awareness and technical competence in all aspects of maintenance and preservation work on and around the vessel.
  • They act as a technical leader to all technicians using their seniority, technical experience and knowledge.
  • They can delegate work and responsibilities to technicians during the execution of their routines.
  • They act as a Technician when required by workload and/or requested by the Supervisor.

Authority

  • A Mechanical Technician Lead is authorized to maintain and repair vessel mechanical equipment and systems.

Immediate Subordinates

  • Mechanical Technicians, Subcontractors, Visitors and Vendor Representatives

Accountable For: Responsibilities & Standards

  • Dismantle, Repair and Reassemble Mechanical Equipment.
  • Identify potential sources of hazard prior to dismantling.
  • Use correct procedures and correct method of dismantling.
  • Carry out the correct isolation and disconnection procedure.
  • Identify, check and prepare components.
  • Apply appropriate tests and test equipment to ensure reassembly is correct and effective.
  • Use of Condition Monitoring on Mechanical Equipment – Adjust instruments to meet operating specification, with minimum disruption and waste.
  • Monitor and record work history or log.
  • Diagnose faults in Mechanical Equipment – respond promptly, select appropriate tests and diagnostic procedures, carry out visual, close and detailed inspections, use results to determine appropriate actions, and record accurate descriptions in documentation.
  • Monitor and maintain pollution control measures – identify unplanned discharges, halt where possible, report as required, use suitable PPE, dispose materials appropriately, enforce protection with colleagues.
  • Contribute to the health and safety of the working environment – keep work area clean, take positive action to stop hazards, raise alarms, alert colleagues, report incidents.
  • Emergency response – carry out emergency response role and demonstrate competence in drills and exercises.

  • Offshore – Routine Servicing of Systems and Equipment
  • Offshore – Rectifying Faults in Systems and Equipment
  • Offshore – Handover
  • Offshore – Emergency Response
  • Offshore – Diagnosis and Fault Finding
  • Offshore – Planning Work
  • Offshore – Dismantling, Repair and Reassemble Equipment
  • Offshore – Safety Management

Pre-hire Qualifications And Experience

  • Proven experience and/or qualification to N/SVQ/HNC/HND in Mechanical Engineering or local equivalent.
  • Experience desired with offshore experience preferred.
  • Experience and knowledge of hydrocarbon processing systems and utilities.
  • Good experience of Permit to Work, Mechanical Isolation Standards and Risk Assessment.
  • Proficiency in English at a minimum of B2 level according to the CEFR international standard.
  • Medically fit according to the Company GEMS Instruction Health Requirements to Work Offshore.

description:
Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager

Department: Ticketing, Hospitality & Stadium Revenue

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. Work in close consultation and collaboration with FIFA Zurich.

The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

Ensuring an exceptional and consistent approach in the planning phase as well as throughout the tournament.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.
  • Design and implement Ticket Sales Strategy for the project, including but not limited to ticket products, sales phases, and pricing strategies tailored to different market segments.
  • Conduct market analysis to optimise sales projections and adapt pricing dynamically.
  • Collaborate with the ticketing project management as well as the CRM team to ensure strategies and processes are aligned.
  • Collaborate with the FIFA Hospitality team and the Official Hospitality Provider to ensure Hospitality’s product positioning and pricing is integrated into the overall ticketing strategy and objectives.
  • Engage with local communities, fan groups, and host city stakeholders to drive awareness and interest in the tournament.
  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to build and ensure the alignment of ticketing and hospitality promotions with overall event campaigns and timelines.
  • Build and manage relationships with domestic stakeholders incl., venue operators, host cities and key stakeholders to optimize ticketing and hospitality opportunities.
  • Monitor ticket sales performance, analyze data, and provide regular reports with insights and recommendations for improvement, with a particular focus on strategies to increase sales, attendance, and overall revenue.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA ticketing standards, operational guidelines, and relevant regulations.
  • Conduct post-event analysis to capture learnings for future FIFA tournaments.

YOUR PROFILE

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's or master's degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Sport Management, Marketing, Economics or relevant area.

EXPERIENCE

  • 5+ years’ experience in: Ticket sales for major sports events; including but not limited to the definition of the strategies to increase sales, attendance and revenues – preferably with experience in the Brazilian market.
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project

SKILLS & COMPETENCIES

  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market trends and ticketing legislation
  • Ability to design and execute ticketing strategies that maximize revenue and stadium occupancy.
  • Understanding dynamic pricing, market segmentation, and sales optimization in a large scale event context.
  • Strong skills in developing ticketing products, packages, and pricing models that drive demand.
  • Ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies Diplomatic , able to create and nurture stakeholder relationships.
  • Courteous with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, organised, resilient.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and as part of a team.
  • Good numerical and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise, and be assertive where necessary.

CERTIFICATIONS & REQUIREMENTS

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Flexible working hours, readiness for stand-by duty.
  • Willingness to travel.

  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - ENFERMEIRO ESF AP 3.3
description:
Overview

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nº 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Programas e Estrutura

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades

Desenvolver a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem à população sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual e coletiva, incluindo ações no domicílio, conforme epidemiologia local. Realizar a organização das atividades das equipes de trabalho, bem como dos processos de enfermagem sob sua responsabilidade. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, a integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

Horário de Trabalho: 40h semanais.

Qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe
  • Preencher os requisitos da Resolução SMS nº 4856 de 31/03/2021:
  • Art. 1º Define como requisito obrigatório para a atuação do enfermeiro na equipe de saúde da família ao menos
  • §1º Título de especialista em saúde da família.
  • §2º Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação lato sensu aos moldes de residência em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
  • §3º Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação lato sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
  • §4º Certificado de conclusão de pós-graduação stricto sensu em saúde da família, saúde pública ou saúde coletiva.
  • §5º Ter no mínimo 4 (quatro) anos de experiência de atuação direta nas Equipes de Saúde da Família.

Outras informações

A SPDM é uma associação que oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios onde se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

title: ENFERMEIRO - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II
description:
Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz , que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Garantir o cumprimento de normas, rotinas, regulamentações da Instituição e, das atividades planejadas para assistência, participando, analisando e avaliando os processos de enfermagem e as interfaces com a equipe para promover uma assistência segura e de qualidade.

Ensino Superior em Enfermagem completo

Pós-Graduação completa em uma ou mais das áreas citadas a seguir: Urgência/Emergência (Pronto Socorro), Saúde Pública, Gestão em Saúde ou Residência Multiprofissional em Saúde / Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe

Experiência mínima de 06 meses na função

Escala: 12 horas de trabalho x 60 horas de descanso.

  • Step 3: Avaliação 3 Avaliação

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,PAIS e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, oPAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

ontem, hoje e sempre Escolhemos o gol e corremos atrás dele com tudo. Focamos em poucas prioridades e vamos até o fim, sem distrações. Tratamos cada recurso como se fosse nosso, decidindo rápido e com coragem. Comunicação? Direta, aberta e na velocidade do jogo.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, conforme decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

Atuando nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, a instituição promove políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A principal diretriz da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e promoção da saúde em níveis primário, secundário e terciário, fortalecendo laços com a comunidade local e atendendo a todos sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM amplia suas ações com projetos em andamento na área de Assistência Social e Educação, consolidando-se como uma grande instituição filantrópica que busca sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências — Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação — são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados.

Disponibilizamos um banco de talentos exclusivo para profissionais com deficiência. Inscreva-se para ser direcionado às vagas disponíveis conforme suas qualificações!

A SPDM é uma associação reconhecida por sua atuação social e compromisso com a saúde pública, promovendo ações integradas com a gestão pública, visando garantir acesso universal à saúde, com equipes multiprofissionais de alta qualificação, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 na cidade de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados, buscando melhorar indicadores de saúde e qualidade de vida da população, pautado na integralidade e equidade.

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho com plano de carreira para pessoas com deficiência em suas unidades hospitalares, realizando periodicamente anúncios de recrutamento nos principais jornais das regiões de atuação.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica e compromisso social e ambiental.

ASPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas,Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Desenvolver a sistematização da assistência de enfermagem à populações sob o âmbito da promoção e proteção da saúde, prevenção de agravos, diagnóstico, tratamento, reabilitação e manutenção da saúde individual e coletiva, incluindo ações no domicilio, conforme epidemiologia local. Realizar interface com a Rede Assistencial à Saúde, atuando de forma integral na coordenação do cuidado, através de ações que facilitem o acesso, integralidade, longitudinalidade, resolutividade e a participação da comunidade nos Serviços de Saúde.

title: Volunteer System Manager
description:
Volunteer System Manager

Department: Events & Entertainment

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

Reporting to the Senior Volunteer Manager – FIFA27, the Volunteer System Manager will play a key role in shaping and managing the volunteer journey through the FIFA Volunteer Platform, supporting operations across eight Host Cities within the Integrated Model.

The purpose of this role is to lead the set‑up, operation, and maintenance of the FIFA Volunteer Platform, which serves as the foundation for the entire volunteer experience. The successful candidate will also oversee essential system integrations to ensure a seamless, efficient, and high‑quality operational process for the tournament. This role will work in close collaboration with the Volunteer Management Teams at FIFA Zurich, FIFA27, Host Cities in Brazil and the FIFA Volunteer Platform provider, as well as with other Functional Areas, to ensure the technology platforms meet all operational requirements while supporting the successful delivery of the Volunteer Programme.

We are seeking an innovative and experienced systems professional with a proven record in managing complex, large‑scale event operations. The ideal candidate will join a dynamic, multicultural environment and bring both strategic insight and firsthand expertise to one of the most exciting sporting events in the world.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Work on development of all system processes in the FIFA volunteer platform, from application through to tournament‑time management, including test events and satellite events
  • Participate in the planning phase to finalise configuration of the FIFA Volunteer Platform ensuring it fully supports the requirements of the Integrated Model for a consistent volunteer experience and operational processes across all Host Cities.
  • Support the review and refine system functionalities to meet the evolving needs of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.
  • Ensure operational readiness to test and finalise the application form for the Volunteer Programme launch.
  • Ensure integration with other FIFA and local systems, managing all dependencies.
  • Act as the volunteer department’s main point of contact for User Access, User Validation, UAT (User Acceptance Testing), and system simulations.
  • Identify and propose technical solutions to operational challenges not addressed by existing functionality.
  • Ensure data integrity, compliance, and security across all volunteer systems in‑line with FIFA’s data protection standards.
  • Act as the first point of escalation and resolution for volunteer system issues.
  • Promote best practices in data management, analytics, and system governance.
  • Lead the creation of data reports, dashboards, and analytical tools for operational insights and decision‑making.
  • Monitor and report on project timelines, change requests, and system risks in line with the integrated volunteer systems plan.
  • Establish clear reporting and monitoring processes to evaluate programme effectiveness, volunteer satisfaction, and service delivery.
  • Lead the preparation and delivery of training materials and conduct “Train‑the‑Trainer” sessions for system users.
  • Ensure compliance to the FIFA tournament guidelines and oversee project execution in alignment with the approved budget, identifying efficiencies and cost‑effective delivery methods.
  • Contribute to the development and implementation of an International Volunteer Welcome Strategy, including logistics, visa facilitation, and cultural integration.
  • Ensure a structured systems close‑out process, including comprehensive handover and debrief report.
  • Represent the Volunteer team in cross‑functional area meetings, host city briefings, readiness workshops, stakeholder engagements, and strategic planning.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in large‑scale volunteer, workforce, or sport event programme management.
  • Education: Master’s in Sports Management or Event Management or Technology, Information Systems, or Project Management preferred.
  • Proven experience managing large‑scale technology or systems implementation projects.
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and project management skills.
  • Strong analytical and reporting skills, including proficiency with data visualisation and business intelligence tools.
  • High cultural awareness with experience in multi‑stakeholder and multicultural environments.
  • Training delivery experience a plus
  • Familiarity with volunteer management systems (Rosterfy) and related IT tools is highly desirable.
  • Ability to be flexible and adopt an innovative mindset
  • Team player with internal and external stakeholders
  • Ability to thrive in an international, dynamic, and fast‑paced environment.
  • Collaborative and empathetic team player, passionate about community‑building, sport, and service.
  • Creativity and resourcefulness to enhance the volunteer experience and drive engagement.
  • Anticipates needs, understands the strategic impact of systems, and drives continuous improvement.
  • Project management or Systems Management certification is desired
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re‑locate to Rio de Janeiro.

The Senior Manager Event Logistics ensures the most favorable conditions for the successful establishment & implementation of the Event Logistics project within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™. The objective of the Event Logistics Project is the design and implementation of a robust supply chain which includes the infrastructure, to support the movement of goods between the host country venues, including stadiums, team base camps, training sites, the International Broadcast Centre, the Main Media Centre and other official sites.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Overall responsibility for the management, coordination and leadership of the Logistics team and sub-projects:
  • International freight forwarding, including the international movement as well as customs clearance of goods into and out of the host country
  • Conception and implementation of simplified customs procedures together with the involved government authorities to ensure the smooth importation and exportation of goods for all tournament stakeholders
  • Central warehousing, including asset tracking not only within the warehouse but across all venues in which there assets provided by Logistics
  • Material planning, including the gathering of Furniture, Fixture and Equipment (FFE) requirements from all functional areas, working with Procurement in sourcing these requirements and delivery
  • Domestic distribution of FFE, FIFA assets, uniforms and other commodities o Movements of team luggage and equipment to / from hotels, airports, stadiums and training sites and between host cities
  • Managingthe entry to venues of delivery and collection vehicles during the tournament period via the Master Delivery Schedule System (MDS)
  • Providing Venue Logistics Services, including un- / loading services, determining the storage space requirements of Logistics and other functional areas, distribution of items inside the venues, providing of FFE
  • Where / if required development of IT solutions for Master Delivery Schedule (MDS), Material Planning tool, Venue Delivery Portal (VDP) and Logistics Customer Relationship Management tool (LCRM)
  • Procurement and management of golf carts pool at venues
  • Development of a dissolution strategy, in cooperation with the tournament management, legal, procurement and all item procuring functional areas
  • Evaluation of the local logistics market and contracting a Logistics Service Provider (LSP) to provide warehousing, trucking, and people resources as required

  • Provide timelines and accurate reporting to FIFA Zurich Event Logistics and Senior Management
  • Complete the final reconciliation, close the contracts and transfer the knowledge post-tournaments

YOUR PROFILE

title: Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice
description:
Network Solution Architect - Data and Voice

1GLOBAL is a technology‑driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best‑in‑class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital‑first businesses—including neo‑banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

Position Overview

As an Architect inside the Network Engineering department, you will act as a Solution Architect for new products, services and technologies in 1GLOBAL, acting as a point of contact towards internal and external customers. Effectively work closely with Product and Marketing, but also with all different technical stakeholders and vendors, in shaping, designing, testing, and implementing new solutions. The Architect is responsible for leading the requirements analysis process, in close contact with all relevant stakeholders, to a refined and clear scope, allowing a solution to be created, documented and planned to be implemented.

We are open to hiring for this position in São Paulo, Brazil. The successfully hired candidate will receive onboarding and training in Lisbon, gaining valuable skills while experiencing one of Europe's most dynamic and renowned cities.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key Responsibilities

  • Iterates with the customer (internal and external) and other stakeholders to determine the technical requirements, risks, technical impacts, and recommendations
  • Design of new consumer and corporate telecom solutions
  • Collaborates with technical teams in defining reliable, modular, scalable, and customer‑centric solutions, as well as planning and reviewing solutions
  • Design and present solutions in documents and workshops. For the solution identifies the impacts, efforts and the resources needed
  • Market prospection of new solutions through elaboration and analysis of Request for Information/Proposal/Quotation processes and negotiation with potential suppliers
  • Follow up of new technology trends in the Telecom industry and identifying interesting solutions for the product portfolio
  • Definition and follow up of company technological evolution roadmaps
  • Documents the existing technology portfolio and proposes recommendations for improvements and / or alternatives
  • Ensure and control quality of documentation execution (HLD's, LLD's, WO's, etc.)
  • Ensure and control implementation quality. Understanding of End to End system testing requirements
  • Ensure the network is compliant with industry standards and regulations
  • Capacity and Performance Analysis, Reporting and Improvement Solution Definition
  • Work on complex solutions that influence the design of current products and addresses design issues for future products or technologies. Enhance, simplify, and optimize existing applications and processes
  • Evolves the engineering maturity to be on par with the non‑functional and functional state‑of‑the‑art
  • Communicates transparently to the whole business
  • Reaches out to other teams and works towards alignment and overall continuous improvement

Requirements

Must Have

  • Excellent understanding of Mobile Networks and its architectures
  • Experience with MVNO architecture(s) and landscape. Familiar with roaming environment, including its technical, commercial and regulatory aspects
  • Solid knowledge of networking principles & protocols, including security
  • Experience in network protocols like MAP, CAMEL, SIGTRAN, DIAMETER, SIP
  • Knowledge and experience of OCS and Gy/Sy interfaces
  • Experience with VoLTE and VoWiFi
  • Experience with LTE, 5G, IMS, IP technologies and protocols
  • Familiar with cloud‑based solutions and virtualization technologies
  • High Level Designs and Low Level Designs. Experience developing and presenting internal and external documents
  • Experience with 5G Core Mobile Networks
  • Experience with monitoring tools and protocols in Mobile Networks
  • Anticipates problems and addresses them before they cause impact
  • Understands how big‑picture goals inform technical details and vice‑versa
  • Ability to work in complex environments (multi‑cultural/multi‑country/geographically distributed teams)
  • High attention to detail. Doesn't leave things to be addressed or left undone
  • Business oriented, capable to engage and discuss with non technical persons in order to create technical requirements
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills
  • English proficiency mandatory, other languages are a plus
  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience

Nice to Have

  • Experience with cloud applications monitoring and analytics is a plus
  • Experience with AI/ML cloud based service assurance is a plus
  • Extensive working experience on telecoms, designing and implementing mobile core networks

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year‑on‑year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast‑paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting‑edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results‑driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Description

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Host Broadcast Production Manager will report jointly to the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast in Brazil and the Zurich-based Senior Host Broadcast Production Lead. The role is responsible for the planning, coordination, and implementation of all broadcast-related infrastructure and overlay, ensuring successful delivery of the tournament.

This includes close collaboration with all FIFA27 functional areas, Host Country/City representatives, stadium authorities, and relevant stakeholders. Key milestones under the role’s scope include the Final Draw, two Play-off Tournaments, and the main tournament period (June–July 2027).

The position will require periods of extended travel and operational hours, attendance at site inspections. The selected candidate will also be expected to escalate risks, critical progress updates, and potential delays to FIFA HQ in Zurich.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Ensuring the compliance of the broadcast areas at the 8 stadiums within Brazil, in accordance with FIFA requirements.
  • Liaising closely with Host Cities, Stadiums, and FIFA27 Local Entity counterparts on the on-going development of broadcast facilities including access and zoning through all phases of the project.
  • On-going collaboration with the FIFA27 Local Entity Technical Services and Containment Managers, Overlay Teams, and Stadium Authorities in the planning and preparation for all host broadcast and unilateral broadcast-related overlay. As well as legacy infrastructure at the venues including camera platforms, broadcast cable pathways, Studios and presentation positions, Interview Areas, Broadcast commentary positions and all installations within the Broadcast Compound.
  • Supervise, in coordination with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals/departures of technical facilities at the Broadcast Compound.
  • Ensuring the necessary overlay infrastructure is provided on schedule ahead of the arrival on-site of the host broadcaster.
  • Work closely with the overall venue management teams for planning, development, and delivery.
  • Leading weekly, fortnightly and monthly reporting documentation and meetings on the tournament planning progress, managing and resolving risks and issues for venues within the assigned country, and escalating any urgent issues to the Head of Broadcast and Project Lead in a timely manner.
  • Working across multiple time zones, to ensure you are the main point of contact and support for the Project Lead and Host Broadcast Production department based in Zurich, as well as the FIFA27 Head of Broadcast based in Rio De Janeiro FIFA office, Work closely with the Media Partners and Relations department and Content Production Teams to ensure seamless host broadcast and unilateral broadcast planning and operations at the venues.
  • Supervision, in close collaboration with the Host Broadcaster, all arrivals and departures to the Broadcast Compound of all technical facilities and other deliveries.
  • Main point of contact for Project Lead and the Host Broadcaster, liaison and support for areas such as match day broadcast accreditation and access issues, radio frequencies, broadcast security, broadcast cleaning and schedule control, unilateral broadcasters’ filming requests, stadium visits, issue resolutions, etc.
  • Pre-planning, onsite support and delivery for the Play off Final tournaments, draw event and any other such event including internal workshops, training sessions, etc.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a comparable role within an international, fast-paced environment involving complex projects — ideally in the broadcasting of events and within the sports industry.

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Position Summary

The Vice President of Clinical Operations and Finance is a senior leadership role responsible for the strategic oversight and operational excellence of clinical and financial functions across the Faculty Practice Plan. This role ensures the delivery of high-quality, cost-effective care while maintaining financial sustainability and regulatory compliance. The Vice President will lead cross‑functional teams, optimize workflows, and collaborate with executive leadership to drive innovation, performance, and growth. The Vice President will implement the FPP’s Strategic 2030 Market Expansion plan. The Vice President reports to the Chief Executive Officer of the FPP.

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute integrated strategies that align clinical operations with financial goals and institutional priorities.
  • Lead initiatives to scale clinical services, improve patient access, and enhance operational efficiency.

Clinical Operations Oversight

  • Direct multi‑disciplinary teams to ensure effective execution of clinical workflows, service delivery, and compliance.
  • Implement and monitor KPIs such as patient wait times, double‑booking volume, appointment utilization rates, and provider panel sizes to drive operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with department chairs to improve workflows and improve access to care across high‑volume specialties.

Financial Management

  • Direct the preparation and distribution of monthly financial reports, including service line profitability, provider productivity, and departmental budget performance.
  • Monitor provider productivity (e.g., wRVUs, cFTEs) and ensure alignment with MGMA benchmarks.
  • Lead the annual operating budget process, including baseline development, variance analysis, and iterative forecasting in collaboration with finance partners.

Performance Optimization

  • Conduct quarterly performance reviews for clinical departments and individual providers, analyzing wRVU trends, encounter volume, charges, and payments.
  • Lead performance reviews and develop action plans to enhance clinical and financial outcomes.
  • Lead Lean Six Sigma or DMAIC projects to reduce operational waste, improve patient flow, and enhance financial performance.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Facilitate regular strategy sessions with senior leadership, department chairs, and finance teams to align clinical and financial priorities.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to support strategic initiatives and operational goals.
  • Serve as the primary liaison for external consultants, payers, and vendors involved in clinical operations and financial planning.

Compliance & Risk Management

  • Ensure all clinical operations adhere to CMS, Joint Commission, and institutional compliance standards.
  • Identify operational risks (e.g., underperformance, billing inefficiencies) and develop mitigation plans in collaboration with legal and compliance teams.

Qualifications

Education

Master’s degree in Health Administration, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field required.

Experience

Minimum of 5–7 years of progressive leadership experience in healthcare operations and finance. Proven success in managing clinical productivity, financial planning, and strategic initiatives.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team management capabilities.
  • Advanced financial modeling and analytical skills.
  • Expertise in healthcare operations, provider compensation, and performance metrics.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 and financial reporting tools.
  • Familiarity with EHR systems, digital health platforms, and regulatory compliance.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

title: Consultor Técnico Doenças Raras NF1 - Rio de Janeiro/RJ
description:
Consultor Técnico Doenças Raras NF1 - Rio de Janeiro/RJ

Você está pronto para fazer a diferença na vida de pacientes com doenças raras? Como Consultor Técnico de Doenças Raras - NF1 , você terá a oportunidade de atuar em um ambiente dinâmico e inovador, onde seu conhecimento técnico e habilidades de comunicação serão fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e a conscientização sobre nossos produtos. Junte-se a nós em Recife e ajude a transformar o futuro da saúde!

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Criar e manter planos de atividades ou ações específicas da conta estrategicamente direcionados que reflitam uma compreensão profunda da dinâmica do território para a geração de demanda dos produtos da BU doenças raras.
  • Identificar oportunidades de crescimento no território, propondo ações e atuando com rapidez e eficácia.
  • Promover e/ou participar de eventos relacionados aos produtos da BU de Doenças Raras.
  • Gerenciar com eficácia o tempo, os recursos, a carga cognitiva e de trabalho.
  • Rastrear as atividades e enviar relatórios diversos sobre o negócio e demandas da BU, com precisão e pontualidade.
  • Revisar e propor melhorias no cadastro de médicos da região de sua responsabilidade, com foco em identificação de novas oportunidades de educação médica para conhecimento das doenças, diagnósticos e na manutenção dos tratamentos oferecidos pelos produtos da BU de Doenças Raras.
  • Desenvolver e manter um forte conhecimento técnico‑científico das doenças, diagnóstico e nossos tratamentos, com raciocínio clínico aprofundado para estabelecer discussões coerentes e robustas, que possam auxiliar os HCPs e demais stakeholders na tomada de decisões na jornada dos pacientes.
  • Trabalhar com o mais alto grau de profissionalismo e de acordo com os valores, as políticas da empresa e, principalmente, o nosso Código de Ética e Conduta Empresarial.
  • Construir relacionamentos de confiança com todas as partes interessadas internas e externas, agir proativamente com equipes multifuncionais para refinar iniciativas relacionadas a produtos e doenças.

Competências

  • Capacidade técnica: possuir profundo conhecimento de patologias (diagnóstico, doença e tratamento), se manter atualizado com os temas relacionados ao negócio.
  • Comunicação: desenvolver e transmitir informações de forma clara, objetiva e eficiente (verbal e escrita).
  • Tomada de decisões: tomar decisões apropriadas e oportunas para garantir o bom andamento dos negócios.
  • Resiliência: aprender diante de situações difíceis e administrar ambiguidades e complexidades.
  • Perfil analítico: analisar o ambiente, cenários, dados, mercado e a partir desta análise gerar informações de valor, conhecimento, possibilidades presentes e futuras relacionadas a políticas, práticas, tendências que possam contribuir para o negócio.
  • Planejamento estratégico: gerenciar bem o tempo, planejar suas atividades a cada trimestre levando em consideração a necessidade de cobertura dos KPIs de execução de campo definidos para o negócio pela liderança da BU, antecipar problemas propondo soluções viáveis, olhar para possibilidades futuras e convertê-las em decisões e ações táticas.
  • Trabalho em equipe: construir e estimular relacionamentos sólidos e éticos com todo time, praticar e apoiar o compartilhamento de boas práticas, colaborar com todas as áreas, responsabilizar‑se com os resultados coletivos e respeitar a inclusão e diversidade.

Qualificações Essenciais

  • Graduação completa (administração, marketing ou na área de saúde).
  • Experiência como consultor de vendas de doenças raras e/ou no alto custo e acesso complexo na indústria farmacêutica, biológicos e/ou especialidades, geração de demanda (oncologia, hospitalar, imunologia, transplantes etc.).
  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) válida.
  • Disponibilidade para viajar regularmente no território - Região Sudeste (> 50% do tempo).

Residência fixa no local sede da vaga.

Qualificações Preferidas

  • Inglês de nível intermediário.
  • Pós-Graduação/ MBA.
  • Experiência em doenças raras e em especialidades (pediátrica e adulta) como oncologia, neurologia e genética.

Com experiência em gestão de negócios, desde 1955, a WLM atua no segmento automotivo e no agronegócio.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania , como caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, na prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais 20 pontos do país, atendendo a 06 estados diferentes, sendo Equipo - RJ, Itaipu - MG, Itaipu Norte - PA, Quinta Roda - SP e Supermac - AM e RR.

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos e produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com grande preocupação pela conservação do meio ambiente, as atividades produtivas são executadas visando as melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas e cuidados com as águas e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética.

Com essa aquisição, a WLM amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

A localização estratégica das unidades permite uma atuação com abrangente cobertura geográfica, garantindo presteza, qualidade e agilidade no atendimento.

A sua holding está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e possui uma filial corporativa em Minas Gerais, na Cidade de Contagem.

title: Design Director, UI/UX & Brand
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring a Design Director - a visionary leader with a strong design background who thrives in driving high-quality design execution across various platforms as well as managing creative talent. You’ll combine strategic oversight with hands‑on involvement, ensuring that every design project meets the highest standards of excellence.

That role requires deep experience in branded UI/UX design. You’re a senior-level design lead that can independently own multiple web design engagements simultaneously. Navigating client feedback and pushback is an everyday muscle you successfully work with. You can show deep experience in being able to thread the needle between game‑changing UI, conversion‑oriented UX, and technical feasibility, all on a tight timeline. Clients are consistently impressed by your knowledge of e-commerce heuristics and how you combine that with unique and branded design. You love working with developers to understand how to make your ideas come to life and sell clients on design solutions and tradeoffs they have to make to complete engagements on‑time.

You pride yourself on being able to effortlessly spin up a new brand design system for a client that feels differentiated, elevated, and informed by your strategic market analysis. You have consistently merged business thinking with exceptional visual craft into scalable brand identities that work across paid media, retention, web, social, and packaging.

In addition to your individual contributor responsibilities, you will report to the Director of Creative and play a key role in guiding a talented team of designers, overseeing the delivery of exceptional designs for paid ads, emails, landing pages, and e-commerce web design. With your deep expertise in UI/UX and brand design, you’ll empower your team to elevate their skills while maintaining a high bar for creative output and attention to detail.

This role requires a balance of creativity, business strategy, and leadership in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and development teams to ensure the alignment of design goals with broader business objectives. Your ability to drive creative strategy and manage multiple projects with precision will be essential to your success. Darkroom is a career incubator for ambitious talent looking to operate at the intersection of business, design, and innovation.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

Senior Individual Contributor Responsibilities:

  • Lead 1-3 UI/UX engagements as needed, focusing on creating branded e-commerce websites.

  • Emphasize branded UI, conversion‑focused UX, and clarity in design approaches.

  • Present design work to clients, explaining design choices based on effective reasoning and UX principles.

  • Manage design projects independently from discovery to hand‑off, adhering to timelines and collaborating with developers to ensure feasibility.

  • Develop component systems and maintain design guidelines for consistency.

Management Responsibilities:

  • Manage a team of designers, starting with 2-4 direct reports and expanding as the team grows. Provide support in strategy, project management, design feedback, performance evaluation, and handling escalations.

  • Conduct weekly 1:1s with direct reports to assess client health, offer feedback, and oversee career development.

  • Ensure high-quality work output from direct reports, focusing on visual craft, UX expertise, and meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including marketers, strategists, developers, and clients, to develop project plans, understand business objectives, and address client issues.

  • Refine internal processes for client work in coordination with the Director of Creative. Provide training and feedback to enhance the skills of the design team.

You Should Apply if this Sounds Like You:

  • 3-6+ years of senior‑level web design experience with e‑commerce companies, with at least 1 year of people management experience preferred. Must have experience in responsive web design.

  • Digital portfolio showcasing web design and branding skills, including color theory, hierarchy, composition, and typography.

  • Self‑motivated, proactive, and detail‑oriented with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Experience collaborating with developers and documenting designs for development hand‑off.

  • Comfortable with client‑facing responsibilities in English, including leading discovery calls and resolving client feedback.

  • Capable of providing constructive internal feedback and guiding direct reports to improve their work.

  • Ability to tackle ambiguous problems, understand business challenges, design solutions, and execute them effectively.

  • Proficiency in Figma, including features like Auto Layout, Components, and Variants, is essential.

  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator) is required.

  • Bonus: Familiarity with HTML/CSS or frameworks like Tailwind.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

description:
Banco de Talentos para Pessoas com Deficiência

Da soma de todos os colaboradores que compõem nossos times, nascem nossos valores e visão de mundo. Aqui no IDG acreditamos no respeito à diversidade e à inclusão e, pensando nisso, esse banco de talentos é direcionado para Pessoas com Deficiência (PcD) . Para se candidatar é necessário que haja identificação com as características citadas. Caso você não pertença ao grupo descrito, você pode checar outras oportunidades na nossa página de carreiras.

Vale-Refeição e Vale-Alimentação: Disponibilizamos o cartão flexível Ticket Flex , podendo ser utilizado para as funções alimentação e refeição em qualquer estabelecimento com a bandeira Ticket;

Vale Transporte: De acordo com as regras da CLT;

Day off de aniversário: Uma folga para você comemorar o seu dia;

️ Assistência Médica com cobertura nacional da SulAmérica;

Assistência Odontológica Amil: Com ampla cobertura nacional, a adesão do plano é opcional;

Wellhub : Plataforma que oferece diversas redes de academias, estúdios e aplicativos de bem-estar;

Seguro de Vida Prudential: Proteção extra para sua família;

Vale Presente Natal: Valor creditado em um cartão presente para um Natal ainda mais acolhedor;

Convênio com empresas parceiras: Parcerias exclusivas para oferecer vantagens que fazem a diferença no dia a dia;

️ Acesso aos nossos Museus: Acesso gratuito aos nossos equipamentos culturais para você e sua família/amigos.

Vem fazer parte do Time IDG

Somos uma organização social privada sem fins lucrativos, especializada em gerir centros culturais públicos de grande importância para o país e programas ambientais. Atualmente, também prestamos consultorias para a concepção, modelagem, formatação e gestão de projetos, desenvolvendo o escopo, fazendo a captação de recursos, o enquadramento nas leis de incentivo e gerindo sua implementação.

O Paço do Frevo , localizado no coração do Recife, é mais do que um museu; é um guardião do patrimônio mundial da humanidade, celebrando a riqueza e a diversidade de nossa cultura.

O Museu do Amanhã , uma fascinante instituição de ciências no Rio de Janeiro, convida você a refletir sobre nossas ações presentes e seu impacto no amanhã, inspirando mudanças para um futuro melhor.

O Museu das Favelas em São Paulo é um espaço de resiliência e criatividade das comunidades, revelando a potência e o brilho das favelas através de suas histórias e expressões culturais únicas.

O Museu do Jardim Botânico do Rio de Janeiro é uma viagem encantadora pelo mundo da botânica, convidando você a explorar a beleza e a importância das plantas em nossas vidas.

O Programa de Formação Cultural CULTSP PRO - Escolas de Profissionais e de Empreendedores da Cultura, no Estado de São Paulo, oferece cursos em diversas áreas, incluindo Artes Cênicas, Audiovisual, Games, Moda, entre outras.

Sediado na cidade de Belém, o novo Museu das Amazônias , implementado pelo IDG em parceria com o Museu Paraense Emílio Goeldi, será uma referência na área de ciências e tecnologias. Com experiências imersivas e coletivas, irá reunir as muitas Amazônias, nacionais e internacionais, e aproximar os vários setores sociais para debater os temas da área.

Além dos museus, temos também a gestão do Fundo da Mata Atlântica e atuamos na revitalização do Cais do Valongo-RJ .

Nosso propósito é : Esperançar futuros possíveis

  • Criativos na essência: Acreditamos que a criatividade está no nosso DNA. Todos podemos praticá-la no dia a dia, seja na tarefa mais simples ou em projetos complexos;
  • Autenticamente diversos: Somos muitos, somos diferentes e cada vivência e visão de mundo importa. É da soma dessas diferenças que vêm as nossas melhores ideias;
  • Compromisso com excelência: Fazemos sempre o nosso melhor. Nos orgulhamos de estabelecer boas relações com nossos parceiros, colaboradores e todas as pessoas que estão na nossa rede, e de criar espaços encantadores de reflexão e conhecimento.
  • Respeito aos acordos: Entendemos que o respeito vai além da boa educação e deve ser a base no tratamento com qualquer um. Respeitamos os acordos e oferecemos segurança jurídica e financeira para construir laços de confiança.
  • Encantamento: Recebemos as pessoas com prazer e nos orgulhamos quando elas são maravilhadas pelos nossos espaços, seja no ambiente corporativo, seja nos museus. Incentivamos as pessoas a alcançarem o seu potencial e vivemos entusiasmados pelo nosso propósito.

Se você compartilha da nossa paixão por promover o acesso à cultura, preservar o meio ambiente e inspirar mudanças positivas, junte-se a nós! Estamos sempre em busca de mentes criativas e comprometidas para se juntar à nossa equipe e fazer a diferença.

Venha fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!

title: Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027TM
description:
FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”).

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Job Description

The position

Sitting within the Ticketing Department, Ticketing aims to deliver the most engaging, innovative, and accessible Women’s World Cup experience for all athletes, fans, partners, and the community.

Reporting organizationally to the Head of Ticketing, the Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will help serve Ticketing sales, operations and efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil™ 2027 that for the first time ever, will be hosted in South America. Work in close consultation and collaboration with FIFA Zurich.

The Ticketing Sales & Strategy Manager will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive ticket sales strategies to ensure optimal attendance and revenue generation for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 in Brazil. The role requires a strong understanding of the Brazilian sports market, exceptional stakeholder engagement skills, and the ability to drive innovative ticketing initiatives not only across all 8 host cities but in the wider region.

Ensuring an exceptional and consistent approach in the planning phase as well as throughout the tournament.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop and execute ticket sales strategies to maximize revenue and stadium occupancy across all venues.
  • Design and implement Ticket Sales Strategy for the project, including but not limited to ticket products, sales phases, and pricing strategies tailored to different market segments.
  • Conduct market analysis to optimise sales projections and adapt pricing dynamically.
  • Collaborate with the ticketing project management as well as the CRM team to ensure strategies and processes are aligned.
  • Collaborate with the FIFA Hospitality team and the Official Hospitality Provider to ensure Hospitality’s product positioning and pricing is integrated into the overall ticketing strategy and objectives.
  • Engage with local communities, fan groups, and host city stakeholders to drive awareness and interest in the tournament.
  • Collaborate with marketing and communications teams to build and ensure the alignment of ticketing and hospitality promotions with overall event campaigns and timelines.
  • Build and manage relationships with domestic stakeholders incl., venue operators, host cities and key stakeholders to optimize ticketing and hospitality opportunities.
  • Monitor ticket sales performance, analyze data, and provide regular reports with insights and recommendations for improvement, with a particular focus on strategies to increase sales, attendance, and overall revenue.
  • Ensure compliance with FIFA ticketing standards, operational guidelines, and relevant regulations.
  • Conduct post-event analysis to capture learnings for future FIFA tournaments.

Your profile

Education

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration, Sport Management, Marketing, Economics or relevant area.

Experience

  • 5+ years’ experience in: Ticket sales for major sports events; including but not limited to the definition of the strategies to increase sales, attendance and revenues – preferably with experience in the Brazilian market.
  • Planning and delivery of a similar project

Skills & Competencies

  • Deep understanding of Brazilian market trends and ticketing legislation
  • Ability to design and execute ticketing strategies that maximize revenue and stadium occupancy.
  • Understanding dynamic pricing, market segmentation, and sales optimization in a large scale event context.
  • Strong skills in developing ticketing products, packages, and pricing models that drive demand.
  • Ability to translate data insights into actionable strategies Diplomatic , able to create and nurture stakeholder relationships.
  • Courteous with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive, organised, resilient.
  • Ability to work well under pressure, and as part of a team.
  • Good numerical and time management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise, and be assertive where necessary.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools.
  • Flexible working hours, readiness for stand-by duty.
  • Willingness to travel.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

About FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027

The FIFA Women’s World Cup™ is the greatest women’s sporting event on the planet, showcasing the best players in the world on the biggest stage. In 2027, history will be made as Brazil welcomes the tournament to South America for the first time ever.

This landmark event will unite the world through an unprecedented celebration of women’s football, inspiring billions of fans across the globe. As we prepare to host teams and supporters from every corner of the world, we’re looking for passionate, talented individuals to be part of history and help deliver an unforgettable tournament.

Join us and play your role in making FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ a truly extraordinary experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

description:
Join to apply for the Digital Media QA Specialist role at Launch Potato .

Who Are We?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data‑driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote‑first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high‑growth, high‑performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

Why Join Us?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high‑performers.

Contract Non‑Negotiables

  • You’re available to work 40 hours per week, Monday ‑ Friday.
  • You’re comfortable working somewhere between 7:00 am to 6:00 pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • You have outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills and are fluent in English, both written and spoken.
  • You're highly detail‑oriented and reliable.
  • You have excellent administrative skills with the ability to multitask and adapt in a fast‑paced remote environment.

Base Salary

$1,500 ‑ $2,500 (USD) per month.

Your Role

You are a detail‑oriented, results‑driven professional with a passion for maintaining the highest standards of quality and efficiency in operational processes and procedures. Everything goes through QA, so you will be directly responsible for ensuring the success of our campaign launches which connects millions of consumers to our clients monthly! You will also be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operations to ensure they meet and exceed industry standards and organizational objectives. Your unwavering attention to detail and thorough analysis skills will be invaluable in detecting and identifying potential problems within our daily operations. Additionally, you have a proven track record in quality management, process improvement, and possess industry‑specific knowledge. Your ability to collaborate and work cross‑functionally, leveraging your industry‑specific expertise, will enable you to implement effective solutions, making a significant impact on our company's operational excellence.

Success Looks Like

  • Supporting quality assurance for financebuzz.com and allaboutcookies.org domains.
  • Maintaining the currently implemented process for building, setting up, and testing tracking URLs across all campaigns and platforms to ensure the highest quality.
  • Reconciling reporting between internal tracking platforms and external client platforms to ensure proper tracking.
  • Conducting investigations when there is an offer discrepancy or malfunction and finding suitable resolutions.
  • Reviewing platform documentation and internal product setup to find areas of improvement and working with the Operations team to determine next steps to close the gap.
  • Working closely with the Operations team to ensure QA standards are consistently met.
  • Communicating with internal stakeholders on process improvements.
  • Analyzing ad hoc performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Monitoring revenue, conversions, impressions, and clicks to ensure proper reporting when a new offer is created, links are changed, or in other necessary circumstances.
  • Monitoring offer goals to ensure all goals are firing properly after creation.
  • Ensuring QA is successfully implemented with any new process that is rolled out.
  • Quickly becoming a subject matter expert for all QA related processes.

What You Need To Succeed

  • 2-3 years in operations or quality assurance and expertise in digital media advertising.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Understanding of Postback URL tracking and other performance marketing methods of tracking.
  • Experience with Tune & Yieldspark or similar tracking tools.
  • Experience with Asana or other project management tools.
  • Experience with Looker or similar BI tools like Tableau or PowerBI.
  • Proven abilities to analyze performance reports to improve company efficiency of revenue delivery, product improvement, or general site issues.
  • Proven problem solving abilities and #BetterEveryDay mindset.
  • Proactive mindset, searching for opportunities rather than just completing tasks.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills.
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.
  • Ability to work East Coast hours consistently.
